newsitem.title: CHINA: Huangshan Tourism sharply up on debut.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan Tourism sharply up on debut.

text.p: Foreign currency B shares in Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd, making their debut on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Friday, opened up 11.63 percent at $0.288 against an issue price of $0.258.
A total of 80 million B shares in the tourist agency in Anhui province in eastern China were listed today.
Brokers said the rise was mainly due to improved market sentiment on the Shanghai B share market in the past few days.

Shanghai's B share index has been rising for more than a week on rumours that the government would take measures to boost foreign currency share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen. Officials have declined to comment.
"Rises in the past few days have helped improve market sentiment," said one trader. "Huangshan Tourism has benefited, with more investors willing to build positions."
But some traders said they believed the opening price was too high and the shares might correct soon.
After about 15 minutes of trading, Huangshan shares had retreated slightly to $0.278.
